Enemies could not be sent until Wave 10. The send cost of an enemy would be displayed when the enemy is unlocked. The cost of an enemy is the base health of the enemy times four. The send cost does not increase when there are more than one players, despite the health increase. There was some delay between each sent enemy spawn. If an enemy was not unlocked, it would a lock on it. Additionally, a locked enemy would also show when it is going to be unlocked.
